value.rationale: The classical finite Cesàro matrices have logarithmically divergent HS energy; identifying how this intrinsic energy distributes spectrally is naturally motivated and not a chosen arbitrary slice. The theorem gives the exact coefficient for every Schatten even moment and a universal arcsine probability law with finite-size O(1/H_n) polynomial-test errors, all with elementary dimension-independent certificates. No paper-sized application is required; results are substantive beyond an endpoint or table recomputation.
